question: Should OpenClaw support this Discord source-message progress feature through the proposed channel lifecycle and configuration contracts, or require a generic cross-channel early-terminal lifecycle seam first?
rationale: Runtime correctness and live behavior are well supported, but only maintainers can define the permanent Plugin SDK, channel lifecycle, and configuration ownership boundary.

options.title: Adopt with generic seam
options.body: Sponsor the Discord feature while generalizing the core early-terminal callback and keeping all reaction and typing policy inside the Discord plugin.

options.title: Accept current contract
options.body: Approve the channel lifecycle subagentProgress callback and configuration surface as supported API, then require rebase and exact-head upgrade/live proof.

options.title: Pause for unified activity design
options.body: Defer or close this branch if source-message progress should ship only as part of a cross-channel task-activity design.

recommendation.title: Adopt with generic seam
recommendation.body: Sponsor the Discord feature while generalizing the core early-terminal callback and keeping all reaction and typing policy inside the Discord plugin.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision primarily determines Discord product behavior and its channel-owned API boundary.
